name: @libo11y/react-native
description: The libo11y React Native platform for TypeScript: setup over the OpenTelemetry JS 3.x providers on Hermes, the mobile resource, an OTLP/HTTP transport with a persistent retry queue on device storage, AppState flushing, the consent gate, and fetch and XHR spans.
